title: I Canceled 6 Buy Now Pay Later Loans: Here's What Happened
summary: First-person account describes falling behind on six simultaneous BNPL loans and the overdraft fees and budgeting changes that followed.

assertions.quote: My financial life was scattered across six different payment schedules
My checking account balance went from $300 to -47 in less than 6 hours
These companies market convenience, but they profit from your financial desperation
My monthly cash flow immediately improved by $247
